items.title: Decouple canonical generation from MCP request lifetime
items.value: Allow the existing bounded Provider generation to finish under one observable worker even after the initiating MCP request returns.
acceptance: generation start returns the canonical production run identity quickly
normal MCP request completion does not cancel the worker
status polling is read-only and projects run-local metrics
a second start does not duplicate a live worker
canonical publish verifies remote SHA equality
the installed plugin cache and serving runtime are identity-bound to the current managed lifecycle package

items.title: Separate Provider transport success from formal result admission
items.value: Admit a Provider planning result only after identity-bound strict validation, while avoiding a redundant live repair for a safely extractable single JSON object.
acceptance: transport success alone never authorizes formal admission
fenced or commentary-wrapped single JSON objects use deterministic extraction before strict schema validation
invalid schema remains fail-closed without a candidate input artifact
admission events bind the response hash to the materialized planning artifact
canonical publish verifies remote SHA equality

items.title: Restart terminal failed formal generation on explicit revalidation
items.value: Prevent a healthy Provider revalidation from replaying an obsolete REWORK_BLOCKED result without executing the reviewed route.
acceptance: terminal failure statuses create a fresh production entry
waiting checkpoint states resume the same run
successful terminal states are not regenerated
provenance and sealed brief gates remain fail-closed
canonical publish verifies remote SHA equality

items.title: Align CGKN with Attune Qwen provider configuration
items.value: Use one QWEN credential and DashScope transport contract for Attune and the reviewed CGKN route while preserving provenance gates.
acceptance: shared QWEN environment names take precedence over stale CGKN account values
DashScope uses qwen3.7-flash through Chat Completions with thinking disabled
safe diagnostics expose configuration identity but no credential
one bounded live smoke decides whether the sealed provenance run may resume
canonical publish verifies remote SHA equality

items.title: Close reviewed Provider production provenance
items.value: Preserve the reviewed generation route's explicit model policy through requirements planning so a real Provider result can produce a candidate and canonical production provenance without weakening fail-closed gates.
acceptance: requirements planning uses the reviewed run's resolved model policy rather than an unrelated built-in default
unsupported Provider/model combinations remain classified and blocked before candidate acceptance
P01-P12 provenance invariants and deterministic replay remain fail-closed
one bounded real Provider run creates a candidate bound to the sealed brief, Provider result, and provenance
formal evidence evaluates the candidate before resume is considered safe
the canonical repository publish gate verifies remote SHA equality

items.title: Enforce canonical repository publish flow
items.value: Bind tested source identity to an explicit change manifest, exact staging, commit, normal push, remote SHA verification, PR metadata, and bounded CI through one fail-closed publish authority.
acceptance: Git command failure cannot be interpreted as a clean repository
one classifier and one publish authority select an explicit staging set
runtime, generated, secret, and unknown files cannot enter formal staging
test receipts become stale after any covered source change
post-commit verification, remote race detection, normal push, and remote SHA equality are enforced
fast CI checks repository contracts without Provider credentials or product acceptance authority

items.title: Enforce canonical version retirement lifecycle
items.value: Expose only current architecture truth, enforce one active authority per responsibility, and retire superseded production surfaces instead of accumulating parallel implementations.
acceptance: VERSION and current architecture product version agree
one deterministic retirement gate rejects duplicate authorities, expired compatibility, superseded production references, stale current documentation, legacy producers, and version mismatch
deprecation registry contains only live COMPAT_ONLY surfaces with bounded removal versions
at least one obsolete implementation is actually removed or isolated from the active surface
generated and maintained projects receive complexity-tailored supersession and retirement rules without a second generation path
scoped regressions and kernel contract pass while the formal quick profile is reported truthfully

items.title: Reduce requirement decision before clarification
items.value: Create one factual Task Understanding to Project Planning boundary without adding a second question, assumption, planning, or execution authority.
acceptance: legacy question fields are compatibility projections only
template uncertainties are removed
canonical assumption source count is one
understanding readiness gates ProjectPlan construction
governance, Capability/WorkNode, Provider, evidence, packaging, and delivery routes remain intact

items.title: Introduce canonical Component execution model
items.value: Make ports, executable components, and per-run execution facts first-class while preserving the single artifact-driven runtime path.
acceptance: existing module contracts adapt to immutable ComponentSpec values
compiler and runtime use the Component abstraction without a parallel path
ComponentExecution is the canonical per-node execution fact projected into checkpoints and feed rows
compile-time and runtime artifact boundary validation pass
targeted, quick/profile, and kernel contract regressions pass

items.title: Canonicalize validated Calculus Ink Lab candidate
items.value: Route the existing real Math E2E fixture through canonical finalization, packaging, public delivery gating, and receipt production.
acceptance: formal finalization creates and validates the candidate identity
test, runtime, and visual evidence bind the same candidate
local_packager and public_delivery_gate pass for Calculus Ink Lab
a canonical delivery receipt is produced
negative cross-candidate and stale-evidence tests remain fail-closed

items.title: Reduce architecture before reuse and skill learning
items.value: Make the production model smaller for AI while preserving one evidence-backed delivery route, then add bounded reusable executors.
acceptance: reduction acceptance passes before additive work
one canonical WorkNode planning model
capability and interface planning precede implementation
reuse decisions and skill candidates remain bounded executors
canonical evidence, packaging, and delivery remain unchanged

items.title: Repository Layout v1
items.value: Separate source, formal specs, examples, curated evidence, and local runtime data.
acceptance: specs is the formal registry
tracked raw runtime is zero
core flows compile
repository hygiene passes

items.title: Review stable release promotion
items.value: Decide stable release only after independent review of the cleaned Artifact-driven branch.
acceptance: no force push
reviewed integration strategy
formal evidence remains independently evaluated
